body:
I suggest we make 6.5.2 positive.

From:

6.5.2 | [ADDED, SPLIT FROM 6.2.5, COVERS 6.2.3, LEVEL L2 > L1] Verify that insecure ciphers, including Triple-DES and Blowfish, are not used but secure authenticated ciphers and modes such as AES with GCM are. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 326

To:


6.5.2 | [ADDED, SPLIT FROM 6.2.5, COVERS 6.2.3, LEVEL L2 > L1] Verify that secure authenticated ciphers and modes such as AES with GCM are used. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 326

PS: 6.5.3 is also framed negatively at the current moment but is discussed elsewhere currently.
